character: 3rd largest ski area in France — 425 km, 260 pistes, 3 resorts, 2 glaciers, 362 ha snowmaking, Vanoise Express link
description: Second largest linked ski area in France — 425km, 141 lifts, 475 pistes across La Plagne, Les Arcs, and Peisey-Vallandry. Connected by the Vanoise Express — a double-decker cable car crossing the Ponturin gorge. Known for: the Bellecôte glacier (3,417m), Aiguille Rouge (3,226m — 2,000m vertical descent to Villaroger), the world-first AEROLIVE open-air cable car cabins to the glacier. Family-friendly but with serious expert terrain. Les Arcs has Charlotte Perriand's iconic modernist architecture. Snow guarantee is excellent above 1,800m.
key_feature: Vanoise Express — double-decker cable car, 200 people, 2 km span, 4 minutes travel time. Links La Plagne (east) and Les Arcs (west). Opened 2003-04 season, upgraded in subsequent years.

weather_snow.pct_above_2000m: 70% — one of the highest proportions in the Alps
weather_snow.glaciers: Bellecôte (La Plagne) and Aiguille Rouge area (Les Arcs)
weather_snow.key_note: High-altitude domain. Les Arcs: Aiguille Rouge at 3,225m. La Plagne: Bellecôte glacier at 3,250m. Snow record is strong from December through April.
weather_snow.night_skiing: Available at Les Arcs 1600 and 1800 on floodlit runs

name: Paradiski

lift_pass_pricing.family_discount: Family Pack: €25pp discount on max 2 adult + min 2 child passes. Tribe Pack: €10 discount for 3+ identical passes.
lift_pass_pricing.local_pass_6day: La Plagne only €370/6d. Les Arcs only €365/6d. Extension to full Paradiski €27/day.
lift_pass_pricing.discount_info: 6-day pass includes free afternoon skiing on arrival day (from 12:30). Early booking online discounts available.
lift_pass_pricing.insurance: Carré Neige available — check resort-specific pricing.

suitability.beginners: Good — dedicated green zones at Plagne Centre, Belle Plagne, Arc 1800 and 1950. Arc 1600 has gentle greens through the forest. Chill Ski pass €35/day for beginners at Les Coches/Montchavin.
suitability.intermediates: Excellent — Paradiski is built for blue/red cruising. The Trif';ve run (Les Arcs) is a 7km red/blue with views of Mont Blanc. The connection between La Plagne and Les Arcs via the Vanoise Express opens up endless combinations.
suitability.advanced: Very good — Aiguille Rouge summit (3,226m) has the famous 7km black descent with 2,000m vertical to Villaroger. Bellecôte glacier black runs. Off-piste in the Combe de la Chiaupe. La Plagne's Grand Méan area.
suitability.families: Strong family credentials — each village has family zones, toboggan runs, ice rinks (La Plagne, Les Arcs 1800), cinema, bowling (Plagne Centre). Ski schools with English. Fun slopes in Montchavin-Les Coches sector.
suitability.freeriders: Bellecôte glacier off-piste, Col de la Chal (Aiguille Rouge, 2,600m), and the Villaroger sector (exposed, steep, rarely groomed).

signature_runs.name: Aiguille Rouge descent to Villaroger
signature_runs.description: Iconic 7km black from 3,226m to 1,200m — 2,000m vertical, one of the longest single descents in the Alps

signature_runs.name: Trifoulet to Arc 1800
signature_runs.description: Long red cruiser from the Trifoulet ridge down to Arc 1800, panoramic views of Mont Blanc
